headline: Solaria Shares Rise Following Spain Data Center Rule Change
summary: Solaria shares gained ground following a regulatory rule change in Spain concerning data center developments.
why: Solaria Energía y Medio Ambiente is a renewable energy developer whose growth is tied to grid connections and power demand from data centers.

impacts.name: Solaria Energia y Medio Ambiente
impacts.why: Favorable regulatory changes for data center infrastructure facilitate new renewable power deployment opportunities.

why_moved: Regulatory revisions easing data center rules enhance growth prospects for renewable energy suppliers.
